req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that unsupported HTTP methods should return a 405 status code. This is crucial for ensuring that the API behaves predictably and securely by rejecting methods that are not explicitly handled. The test suite includes a positive test to confirm correct rejection of unsupported methods, a negative test to ensure that supported methods do not return 405, and a boundary test to check the behavior with an edge case method.

tests.name: test_unsupported_method_rejected
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running with the /tasks/{task_id} endpoint available.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.patch('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 405

tests.name: test_supported_method_not_rejected
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running with the /tasks/{task_id} endpoint available.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 200

tests.name: test_boundary_method_rejected
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running with the /tasks/{task_id} endpoint available.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.options('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 405
